goal: Prompt caching review: whether stable prompt parts are placed and marked so they can be reused.
use: Prompt caching review: whether stable prompt parts are placed and marked so they can be reused. Use when a model provider's caching is used or could be.

steps.note: List the stable parts. System text, tool definitions and reference material.
Check the order. Stable parts come before anything that changes per call.
Check the markers. Confirm the cache breakpoints are where the stable part ends.
Check the cache hit rate. Note how often a cached prefix is actually reused.
Report. Each prompt with its stable part, the ordering problem and the fix.
